Shell(python3 -c " with open('/tmp/test-navy.pdf', 'rb') as f: raw = f.read() text = raw.decode('latin-1', errors='ignore') # Search for navy color in any operator import re navy_bytes = bytes([0x1a, 0x3a, 0x5c]) # More thorough: find all non-stroking color ops (scn, rg, k) and stroking (SCN, RG, K) ops = re.findall(r'[\d.]+\s+[\d.]+\s+[\d.]+\s+(?:SC|sc|RG|rg)n?', text) for op in ops: parts = op.split() r = float(parts[0]) if abs(r - 0x1a/255) < 0.01: print(f'NAVY FOUND: {op}') # Also search for the border color in hex encoding hex_search = raw.find(b'\x1a\x3a\x5c') print(f'Raw hex match: {hex_search > 0}') # Find all non-0,0,0 color ops for op in ops: parts = op.split() r = float(parts[0]) if not (r == 0 and float(parts[1]) == 0 and float(parts[2]) == 0): print(f'Non-black: {op}') " 2>&1)

Shell(python3 -c  import re with open('/tmp/test-color.pdf', 'rb') as f: raw = f.read() text = raw.decode('latin-1', errors='replace') # Extract every fill-color (scn/SCN, rg/RG) and stroke-color (SCN, RG) operation # These set the current color in PDF. pattern = r'([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+(scn?|SCN?|r[gG]|RG)\b' colors = {} for m in re.finditer(pattern, text): r = round(float(m[1]), 4) g = round(float(m[2]), 4) b = round(float(m[3]), 4) op = m[4] key = (r, g, b, op) colors[key] = colors.get(key, 0) + 1 print('Unique colors found in PDF:') for (r, g, b, op), count in sorted(colors.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True): hex_val = f'#{int(r*255):02x}{int(g*255):02x}{int(b*255):02x}' label = '' if abs(r - 0x1a/255) < 0.02: label = ' ← NAVY' elif abs(r - 0x00) < 0.01 and abs(g - 0x00) < 0.01 and abs(b - 0x00) < 0.01: label = ' ← BLACK' elif abs(r - 0.96) < 0.01 and abs(g - 0.96) < 0.01: label = ' ← HEADER BG' else: label = f' ← UNKNOWN' print(f'{op}: {r:.4f} {g:.4f} {b:.4f} ({hex_val}) x{count}{label}')  2 >& 1)
